blurb: Guests ride vintage railroad passenger cars over 100 years old on a 12 mile round trip between Coopersville and Marne. Many rides include live entertainment and premium class seating offers snacks and beverages. The train travels on 6 miles of track originally built in 1858 and the trip lasts approximately 90 minutes.

checkin: Welcome aboard the Coopersville & Marne Railway. Please make note the date and departure time of your train, also your car and seat assignment. Please plan to arrive 30 minutes before departure time so that you don't miss your train. You may print out your ticket or bring the confirmation of car and seat on your phone. If you have that information you may proceed directly to the boarding area.
